```{=typst}
#set document(title: "CV -- Nikoloz Sirmpilatze, MD, PhD")
#set text(font: "Barlow", size: 11pt)
#set par(justify: true, leading: 0.65em)
#show link: underline
#show strong: it => text(weight: "semibold", it.body)

// -- Heading styles ---------------------------------------------------------
#show heading.where(level: 1): it => {
  set text(size: 20pt, weight: "semibold")
  v(0.2em)
  it.body
  v(-0.4em)
  line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.4pt + luma(160))
  v(0.3em)
}
#show heading.where(level: 2): it => {
  set text(size: 13pt, weight: "semibold")
  v(0.8em)
  it.body
  v(0.1em)
  line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.3pt + luma(200))
  v(0.3em)
}

// -- Helper: two-column entry row -------------------------------------------
#let entry(title, org, date, location: none) = {
  grid(
    columns: (1fr, auto),
    gutter: 0pt,
    [*#title* #if org != none [\ #emph(org)]],
    align(right)[#if location != none [#location \ ] #text(style: "italic")[#date]],
  )
}

// -- Name & contact header --------------------------------------------------
#align(center)[
  #text(size: 24pt, weight: "semibold")[Nikoloz (Niko) Sirmpilatze, MD, PhD]
  #v(0.3em)
  #text(size: 12pt)[Research Software Engineer | Neuroimaging and Behavioural data]
  #v(0.4em)
  #link("mailto:niko@nikosirmpilatze.com")[niko\@nikosirmpilatze.com] | 
  #link("https://www.nikosirmpilatze.com")[nikosirmpilatze.com] | 
  #link("https://github.com/niksirbi")[github.com/niksirbi] | 
  #link("https://orcid.org/0000-0003-1778-2427")[ORCID]
]
#v(1em)
```

## Experience

```{=typst}
#entry(
  "Senior Research Software Engineer",
  "Neuroinformatics Unit, Sainsbury Wellcome Centre, UCL",
  "2022 -- present",
  location: "London, UK",
)
```

- Lead developer of [movement](https://movement.neuroinformatics.dev), a Python toolbox for analysing animal body movements
- Core contributor to [BrainGlobe](https://brainglobe.info/), including building brain atlases for emerging model organisms
- Promoting open-source adoption through talks, training workshops and open resources, including the [Animals in Motion](https://animals-in-motion.neuroinformatics.dev) handbook
- Co-designed [NeuroBlueprint](https://neuroblueprint.neuroinformatics.dev), a lightweight data specification for systems neuroscience

```{=typst}
#entry(
  "PhD Candidate, then Postdoctoral Researcher",
  "Functional Imaging Laboratory, German Primate Center",
  "2017 -- 2022",
  location: "Göttingen, Germany",
)
```

- Studied brain function under anaesthesia using MRI and microscopy across species
- Built Python analysis pipelines with open-source neuroimaging tools
- Contributed to Open Science including [PRIME-DRE](https://prime-dre.github.io) and [brainhack](https://brainhack.org)
